tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250rgya can rdo rje gro lod gyi brgyud 'debs byin rlabs myur stsol bzhugs so// 1$00003001$0000290chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs// sprul sku pad 'byung gu ru mtshan brgyad dang*// rgya gar rig 'dzin bod kyi rje 'bangs la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /byin rlabs sgo 'byed rig 'dzin rdo rje chos// rdo rje'i rgyal tshab me tog mandā ra// mkhar chen mtsho rgyal rdo rje thogs med la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /padma phrin las 'gro 'dul gter bdag gling*// ngag dbang klu sgrub ngag dbang 'jigs med zhabs// 'gyur med mchog grub padma tshe dbang la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /'jigs med go cha bstan 'dzin 'phel rgyas dang*// brgyud srol kun 'dus 'khor lo'i dbang phyug sogs// byin rlabs char 'beb rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /'chol ba'i khro rgyal rdo rje gro bo lod// phyag rdor gshin rje rta mgrin me dbal dang*// sgo skyong lha tshogs chos srung bcas pa la// gsol ba 'debs so bdud las rnam rgyal shog /'chol ba'i khro rgyal rdo rje gro lod kyi// lha sngags ye shes rnal 'byor la brten nas// rgyal 'gong dam sri la sogs 'byung po rnams// tshar chod mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol//
ces pa'ang brgyud 'debs snga ma la kha skong bcas mkhyen brtse'i dbang pos bris pa dge/ //
